data.subject: YEWsletter - November 12
data.preheader: Join us at Monday's board meeting
data.intro:
Hello YEW Crew,

Feeling emotions about your child's school-related screen use? You are not alone! Join us at the **HVRSD Board Meeting on Monday 11/16 at 6:30 pm** (Central High School Community Room). During the public comment time, parents and allies will show their support for our district's prioritization of face-to-face learning and the intentional use of instructional technology (in class and at home).

[RSVP here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSefjugHPJMCRSgnnmmT6ATGM7xIZloarzg1XSd9tjqIbHnH5A/viewform?usp=dialog) to let us know you're coming (and if you plan to share a comment or just attend in solidarity and support) and add it to [your calendar](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE&text=ecoPTO+Beyond+Screens+Circle+at+the+HVRSD+November+School+Board+Meeting&dates=20261116T233000Z%2F20261117T003000Z&details=Feeling+emotions+about+your+child%27s+school-related+screen+use%3F+You+are+not+alone%21%21%21+Join+friends+from+the+ecoPTO+to+share+your+experience+during+the+public+comment+section+at+November%27s+School+Board+meeting.%0A%0AMonday%2C+November+16%0A%0A**6%3A30**-8%3A30pm%0A%0A%40+Central+High+School+%28community+room%29%0A%0A%5Bhttps%3A%2F%2Fwww.hvrsd.org%2Fevents%3Fid%3D50991629%5D%28https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hvrsd.org%2Fevents%3Fid%3D50991629%29&location=Community+Room%2C+Central+High+School)! 

And read on for upcoming events/ways to help as we work together for Y.E.W. (youth and earth wellbeing)!
data.closing:
Crew, get excited -- over 200 parents have signed our [petition for intentional tech](https://sites.google.com/view/intentional-tech-hvrsd/parent-petition-for-intentional-tech) so far!  Check out the [interactive version here](https://ecopto.org/petition/) and add your name, pass it on, and join us at this Monday's school board meeting as we advocate for 5 common-sense instructional tech milestones across all grade levels.

Count and be counted,

Karen Le Morvan, ecoPTO communications
